component.name: Kaeru
component.summary: Keep your computer awake on request

description.p: Kaeru asks your desktop to prevent automatic sleep and screen blanking for 15 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour, 2 hours, or until you turn it off. Choosing a new duration replaces the current request. It uses the desktop's own mechanisms (xdg-desktop-portal Inhibit, with a logind fallback) and never synthesizes input activity or modifies global power settings.
Everything is local: no accounts, no cloud service and no telemetry. A diagnostics page reports honestly what works on your system.

Focused initial release: dependable Keep Awake with a single replaceable request, reliable portal activation/release, corrected frog icon rendering through the supplied PNG artwork, fixed autostart flags and a simpler three-page GUI. Focus Timer, Work Log and Reports are deferred.
